title: Product reviews
description: Create and edit reviews for paid orders, and moderate them.

help.title: About Product reviews
help.overview: A product review belongs to one line of a paid order. The rating feeds that product's average, rating count, and review count. Marketplace reviews are a separate list and do not change these numbers.

sections.title: What you can create
sections.body: The review is tied to a real purchase. It is not a free-standing comment.
items: It points at one paid order and one product on that order.
The reviewer is the order's customer. You do not pick a different person, and you cannot change it later.
Order and product are fixed once the review exists.

sections.title: What you can still edit
sections.body: The text and the score can change. The link to the purchase cannot.
items: Rating, title, and comment can be edited.
The product's rating average, rating count, and review count follow the reviews that are still live.
Deleting a review is a soft delete and it can be restored.

sections.title: Where it shows up
sections.body: The review is moderated here. The product page is where the number is sold.
items: Open the product to see the aggregate the shop uses.
Open the order to see the purchase the review is about.
A till sale does not land in this list. These reviews are catalog orders.
